# What share of its lane-hours does a bowling center need to sell to break even, and how much cash does the ramp-up eat?

> Free bowling center profit calculator: lanes, peak and off-peak lane-hour prices, utilization, leagues, parties and events, food and drink, staffing, rent and a loan become monthly profit, break-even lane utilization, the price change that hits a target margin, the ramp-up cash reserve and payback.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
